verdict.rationale: Make exposes an MCP server that lets LLMs/AI agents run and manage scenarios via natural-language-driven tool calls (e.g., through Claude/ChatGPT as MCP clients), plus AI Agents app/API for agentic automation. However, this is scoped to invoking scenarios/management actions, not full natural-language control over building/configuring the whole platform. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language command coverage for building/configuring scenarios themselves (not just running them), independent/hands-on validation of the NL experience, and detail on how robust natural-language parsing is beyond docs claims.
